title: HiC Artifact Chain v1
description: The ordered post-generation pipeline (services/artifactChain.ts). stageOrder is the CONTRACT: a stage may be skipped by config, never reordered silently. services/artifactChain.test.ts pins the sequence and services/contracts.test.ts pins it against this file.

stageOrder.description: Order rationale: bindPointers before provenance and the evidence gate, because it supplies the pointers both of them read (three prompt-level attempts to make the model carry pointers were measured and failed); scrub before verifying so the verifier sees the reader's text; verify before counting slots so relabels settle first; settle exhibits BEFORE prose so a section can never describe a chart that did not render (deer-flow's exhibits-before-prose rule); measure prose on the final wording; grade after the other gates because it grades them; deckQuality last because it judges the rendered shape against the previous deck.

trace.description: One compact record per stage, for AIR. Decision fields only, never message text.

pass.description: False when any stage refused the artifact (narrow_scope) or errored.

repairInstruction.description: Concatenated model-facing repair text. Empty when everything passed.
